non_scope: Production deployment, release promotion, arbitrary Git writes/merges, infrastructure provisioning or configuration drift remediation; P32 owns production deployment
Automatic Cell/carrier/service failover, active-session relocation, generic reconciliation or self-healing; P25 owns resilience/recovery and P29 chaos/failover certification
Full metrics/logs/traces observability platform, fleet-wide telemetry retention or SLO certification; P24 owns global observability
Compliance policy certification, immutable enterprise audit platform, metering/cost accounting, backup/DR, final security hardening and capacity certification; P21-P28 remain separate
Arbitrary shell, SQL, HTTP destinations, SSH, credential exposure, tenant-authored executable runbooks, destructive actions, privilege escalation or bypass of P04/P08/P13/P18 authority
Frontend/operator console certification and unsupported claims of autonomous production remediation, SLA, RTO/RPO, capacity or zero-touch operations
objective: Implement NXS Sentinel as a constrained platform SRE control plane: trusted bounded signal ingestion, incident correlation, evidence-bound platform reasoning, versioned runbook proposals, durable approval/policy decisions, and fenced execution through source-registered platform SRE adapters. P20 does not execute tenant business mutations and must not synthesize tenant principals or reuse tenant P13/P08 persistence as global infrastructure authority. Architecture and acceptance contract: docs/engineering/nxs-p20-sentinel-design.md; ADR-0101.
